_comment: The six benchmark tasks. Identical natural-language prompts for both arms; the bare arm simply has no plugin to route them. Frozen before any run; changing a prompt invalidates cross-run comparison.

tasks.t1_transcripts: Process the recent meeting transcripts and pull out every commitment that was made - who owes what to whom, and by when. Use the meeting transcript connector to get the transcripts.
tasks.t2_inbox: Triage my inbox: what needs a reply from me, what can wait, and what is noise. Use the email connector.
tasks.t3_brief: Morning brief: what do I need to know today? Check my calendar and email.
tasks.t4_prep: Prep me for my upcoming meeting - who am I meeting, what is open with them, and what should I walk in knowing?
tasks.t5_entities: A few quick questions about my world: What is currently open with Quinn? Who is Mira and what do we have going on together? And do we know anyone named Skyler?
tasks.t6_wrap: Wrap the week for me: what happened, what is still open, and what slipped?

_comment_follow_ups: Second confirm turn, resumed in the same session, both arms identically, verbatim. Added at calibration (2026-08-27): at claude-opus-5 the t1 prompt routes to the preview-first scan flow, which by design writes nothing until the user confirms (draft posture - a trust feature) - a single-shot run therefore measures the preview, not capture. The follow-up is the user's confirmation. RULED IN by M 2026-08-27; text frozen with the prompts.
